rationale: The contract allows rst_n to deassert arbitrarily close to dst_clk and requires a locally synchronised release. dst_state uses the raw port reset, so its release can violate recovery and removal timing and go metastable.
caveats: RDC-003(a) is WARNING Unresolved by specification, so this is an unresolved-bad outcome, not established detection.

RDC-013 is a generic per-source physical obligation that fires on every asynchronous reset. It is not defect-specific and is excluded. RDC-002 (no SDC reset exception) is a constraint disclosure, not this defect.
This is in scope as the RDC part of the clock and reset interaction class. There is no CDC data path.
